detail: The district identifies the three Kakatiya shrines, carved columns, monolithic Nandi and entrance elephants.
The Ministry of Culture describes the Kalyana Mandapa as a separate restoration at Thousand Pillar Temple.

James Fergusson, History of Indian and Eastern Architecture, Vol. I, 1910, p. 433. Exterior measured as 102 by 83 feet 8 inches, with a raised podium 10 feet wide. Figure 252 depicts the shrine doorway.
provenance: Plain archival scan of the original 1910 published work. The plotted terrain and model are independent.
